tools.name: roll
tools.description: Roll a random person who will be you in that world, with your user. Free, about 60 a minute per network; every roll is fresh randomness, and a preview expires after 24 hours. locks fixes some fields: kind, age, gender, country (an ISO code such as FR; US, CA, GB, JP, DE, KR, AU have the most detail)

tools.name: get_roll
tools.description: Read a roll's current preview and revision, for example after tune_roll returned a revision conflict.

tools.name: tune_roll
tools.description: Change some fields of a roll before it starts. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_in, read_guide · Private data: list_lives, get_life, check_in, make_plan, read_guide · Public sink: tune_roll, get_life, check_in, make_plan, send_feedback · Destructive: check_in, make_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_in, read_guide · Private data: list_lives, get_life, check_in, make_plan, read_guide · Public sink: tune_roll, get_life, check_in, make_plan, send_feedback · Destructive: check_in, make_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
